tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled in all builds, development builds included, and that HTTPS is used everywhere with no exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with a single paragraph. It says TLS certificate verification is enabled in all builds, development builds included, and that HTTPS is used everywhere with no exceptions.

The wording comes from two recorded decisions, "verification on all builds" (#22) and "https everywhere, no exceptions" (#25). I left out the retired note that dev builds disable verification. I also left out an older note about plain http for internal hosts, which #25's "no exceptions" contradicts.

The Muninn heartbeat reported 20 hook runs that started and never finished, so a hook may be exceeding its timeout. I didn't investigate it.
